entities.name: SMS indication
entities.description: An information element that may be included to indicate that the ability for the UE to use SMS over NAS has changed.

entities.name: SMS over NAS
entities.description: The capability of the UE to use SMS over NAS signaling.

entities.name: UE SMS ability change
entities.description: Condition where the UE's ability to use SMS over NAS has changed.

relations.description: The SMS indication IE indicates when the UE's SMS over NAS ability has changed.
The change in UE SMS ability establishes a modification in the SMS over NAS property.
